name: Micaela Bastidas
role: Leader of a large Andean uprising against the Spanish in Peru
contribution: A pioneering indigenous leader against Spanish rule in South America, and a martyr for Peruvian independence.

checks.lead: Micaela Bastidas Puyucahua (23 June 1744 – 18 May 1781) was a pioneering indigenous leader against Spanish rule in South America, and a martyr for Peruvian independence. With her husband Túpac Amaru II, she led a rebellion against the Spanish and like him, was executed by the Spanish when the revolt failed. She was a full partner in her husband's enterprises before the revolt, and was described as "an exceptionally able leader of the rebellion."
